title: Make the change clear before the machinery
why: Readers need to understand the proposed change and its evidence without navigating execution details.

change.before: Implementation mechanics obscure the intended outcome.
change.after: A compact brief leads with the change; a receipt separates evidence from human acceptance.

mustHold: Untrusted content is displayed as text.

acceptance.criterion: The proposed change is easy to scan

check.judgment: Review the brief at desktop and mobile widths

units.title: Render brief and receipt
units.goal: Present change, boundaries, and honest evidence states.
